pwa.title: Mobile app
pwa.description_owner: Install Saloneo on your phone and get a notification for every booking, cancellation, leave request or supplier order.
pwa.description_staff: Install Saloneo on your phone and be told about your new appointments and answers to your leave requests.
pwa.description_supplier: Install Saloneo on your phone and be told about every paid order and every message from a salon.
pwa.installed: Saloneo is installed on this device.
pwa.install_how: To install it on this phone:
pwa.ios_step2: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen.
pwa.android_step1: Open Saloneo in Chrome and tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
pwa.android_step2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.blocked: Notifications are blocked for Saloneo. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then come back here.
pwa.ios_install_first: On iPhone, first add Saloneo to your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later), then open the app to turn on notifications.
pwa.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
pwa.error: Notifications could not be turned on. Check your connection and try again.
pwa.native_soon: App notifications are coming very soon. Meanwhile, you get everything by email.
